name: Vectr
description_en:
Vectr is a browser vector graphics editor for shapes, paths, text, imported images and AI-assisted image tasks. Its current FAQ explicitly says it has moved from a free version to paid-only Plus and Premium subscriptions. Older descriptions of Vectr as permanently free should not be used to select a current plan.

Exporting graphics, opening certain file types and using AI have separate conditions. The pricing table advertises commercial/personal use, but the linked license limits generated content to personal, advertising, marketing or promotional purposes and excludes resale or other commercial purposes. That unresolved wording matters before client or merchandise work.
description_zh:
Vectr 是浏览器矢量图形编辑器，支持形状、路径、文字、导入图片及 AI 图像任务。当前 FAQ 明确表示从免费版转为仅有 Plus、Premium 付费订阅，不能用旧的永久免费介绍选择当前方案。

导出图形、打开某些格式及使用 AI 有独立条件。价格表宣传商业/个人用途，但链接许可把生成内容限于个人、广告、营销或推广，并排除转售或其他商业用途；开展客户或商品设计前应解决这个措辞冲突。

core_features.explanation_zh: 付费矩阵列出SVG、PNG、JPG和VECTR导出，应同时保留可编辑母版及交付图片。

sections.title_en: Paid browser editing rather than the historical free offer
sections.title_zh: 付费浏览器编辑及旧免费介绍的边界
sections.en:
The current browser FAQ says the previous free version has been discontinued in favor of paid-only plans. It describes shape creation, path editing, text, image uploads, background removal and text-to-image generation. URL-based real-time collaboration is advertised. Premium’s three concurrent sessions and Plus’s single session are account/session allowances, not documented counts of independently licensed team collaborators.

Editorial fit: evaluate it for scalable web graphics, simple illustrations and shared design review where browser access matters. Do not assume that a vector editor supplies professional prepress, an offline desktop workflow or unrestricted merchandise licensing. SVG is vector-capable, while PNG/JPG are raster outputs; choosing SVG does not convert every embedded bitmap into editable paths.
sections.zh:
当前浏览器 FAQ 表示旧免费版已停止，改为纯付费方案，列出形状、路径、文字、图片上传、背景移除及文生图，并宣传通过 URL 实时协作。Premium 的三个并发会话与 Plus 的单会话是账户/会话额度，不是已核实的独立授权团队协作者数量。

编辑建议：适合评估可缩放网页图形、简单插画和重视浏览器访问的设计协作。不能假定矢量编辑器具备专业印前、离线桌面流程或无限制商品许可。SVG 能表达矢量，PNG/JPG 是位图；选 SVG 不会自动把嵌入位图变成可编辑路径。

sections.title_en: Check imports, editability and the saved master
sections.title_zh: 检查导入、可编辑性及保存母版
sections.en:
A documented, illustrative workflow is to open the browser editor, create shapes/paths and text or upload a source image, refine the design, save it and export SVG, PNG or JPG. The pricing matrix additionally lists VECTR. For a logo-sized illustration, inspect path quality and fonts in the exported file, and keep an editable project rather than relying only on a flattened delivery. Real-time URL collaboration should be tested with the intended recipient and permission settings before sharing client material.

The FAQ lists SVG, PNG, JPG, EPS, AI, PDF and SVGZ as supported formats, but explicitly requires credits to open EPS, AI, PDF and SVGZ. A paid subscription alone therefore does not establish unlimited free conversion of all client files. The read pages do not give per-import costs or guarantee every source effect/font survives; validate one representative file and the account’s credit balance before a batch.
sections.zh:
一个基于文档的示例流程是：打开浏览器编辑器，创建形状/路径和文字或上传原图，修整设计、保存，再导出 SVG、PNG 或 JPG，价格矩阵另列 VECTR。制作小型标志插画时应检查输出路径及字体，并保留可编辑项目，不只留扁平交付图。通过 URL 实时协作时，分享客户材料前应测试接收人和权限设置。

FAQ 支持列表含 SVG、PNG、JPG、EPS、AI、PDF 和 SVGZ，但明确打开后四种需点数，因此付费订阅本身不证明可无限免费转换所有客户文件。实读页面未列每次导入消耗，也未保证源效果/字体完整保留；批量处理前应验证代表文件及账户余额。

sections.title_en: Monthly prices, annual promotion and session limits
sections.title_zh: 月付价格、年付促销及会话限制
sections.en:
The normal browser showed monthly Plus $3.99 and Premium $9.99, excluding tax. The annual view displayed promotional monthly equivalents of $1.99 and $4.99 with annual billing language and a “lock in” offer. The exact charged annual total and promotion applicability were not checked at purchase; these are viewed prices, not a universal perpetual-price guarantee.

Plus lists 1 GB storage and one session; Premium 5 GB and three concurrent sessions. The comparison lists 50/200 included credits for the monthly plans and 600/2,400 for the annual plans, with 23,000+ elements and SVG/PNG/JPG/VECTR export. These different allowance figures do not by themselves establish monthly replenishment of the annual amounts. Credit refresh/expiry, add-on cost, renewal and cancellation terms need account-specific confirmation. The old /en/pricing route initially showed only FAQ; the live navigation led to /design/pricing, which was read directly.
sections.zh:
正常浏览器显示月付 Plus $3.99、Premium $9.99，未含税。年付视图显示促销折合每月 $1.99、$4.99，并写明按年计费及锁价优惠；未在购买步骤核查实际年度扣款总额及适用资格，这些是可见报价，不是统一永久锁价保证。

Plus 列出 1 GB 存储和单会话，Premium 为 5 GB 及三个并发会话。对比表把月付内含点数列为 50/200，年付列为 600/2,400，另含 23,000+ 元素及 SVG/PNG/JPG/VECTR 导出。这些不同额度本身不能证明年付数额会每月补充。刷新/失效、附加点数价、续费和取消需结合账户确认。旧 /en/pricing 起初只显示 FAQ，当前导航指向 /design/pricing，本文直接实读后者。

sections.title_en: Saving failures do not have a documented recovery guarantee
sections.title_zh: 保存失败没有已核实的恢复保证
sections.en:
The FAQ’s advice for an improperly saved design is to check connectivity, try a refresh and contact support. It does not document a guaranteed version history, restore window or local offline cache. A refresh may be inappropriate if unsaved edits are still visible; editorial practice is to preserve an export or record recoverable work where possible before a potentially lossy step.

For production work, verify that the saved project reopens correctly and retain a local delivery/master copy consistent with the license. Separate an upload/conversion problem from an export problem, record the file type and observed error, and check whether a credit-consuming import exhausted its allowance. No saving failure, concurrent session, collaborator permission or recovery was actually exercised here.
sections.zh:
FAQ 对保存不完整的建议是检查连接、尝试刷新并联系支持，未给出有保证的版本历史、恢复窗口或本地离线缓存。如果未保存改动仍可见，刷新可能不合适；编辑建议是在可能丢失内容的步骤前，尽量导出或记录可挽回工作。

正式工作应确认已保存项目可重新打开，并按许可保留本地交付/母版。区分上传/转换问题与导出问题，记录格式及实际错误，检查需点数导入是否已耗尽额度。本研究未实际触发保存失败、并发会话、协作者权限或恢复。

sections.title_en: Resolve commercial-use wording before relying on it
sections.title_zh: 依赖商业用途前先解决条款措辞
sections.en:
The [current linked agreement](https://vectr.com/license-and-services-agreement.html), updated May 13, 2026, grants a revocable, non-transferable service license and retains platform IP. Its content clause permits personal use, advertising, marketing and promotion under a paid subscription but expressly excludes resale or other commercial purposes. It says it prevails over inconsistent agreements. This is narrower than the pricing matrix’s “Commercial + Personal” label; the label alone is not sufficient authorization for stock resale, client deliverables or merchandise.

The agreement also requires stopping service use and destroying all Content on termination, and allows termination in specified circumstances including material breach or third-party provider changes. How cancellation, retained user-owned uploads, existing client output and AI-specific terms interact was not resolved. Obtain a written scope appropriate to the intended use rather than treating paid access as full ownership or an open-source grant. No legal entitlement for a specific project is asserted here.
sections.zh:
[当前链接协议](https://vectr.com/license-and-services-agreement.html)更新于 2026 年 5 月 13 日，授予可撤销、不可转让的服务许可并保留平台知识产权。其内容条款允许付费订阅下的个人、广告、营销及推广用途，却明确排除转售或其他商业用途，并表示冲突时本协议优先。这比价格矩阵的“Commercial + Personal”窄，不能仅靠该标签授权图库再售、客户交付或商品制作。

协议还要求终止时停止服务并销毁全部 Content，列有重大违约或第三方提供商变化等终止情况。取消订阅、用户自有上传、已有客户成品及 AI 专属条款如何相互作用尚未解决。应按实际用途取得明确书面范围，不把付费访问当作完整所有权或开源授权。本文不对具体项目法律资格作结论。
